Derived state: appVersion server-truth->BUILD_VERSION->'dev' resolution (L64-67), sha = BUILD_SHA (L68), updateAvailable = !!updateCheck?.update_available (L69), uptime = uptimeLabel(versionInfo?.uptime_seconds) (L70) — all ported verbatim. Behavior, state names (open/versionInfo/updateCheck/appVersion/sha/updateAvailable/uptime/hasUnseen/newEntries), API paths (/system/version, /system/update-check), the github releases URL, the version+SHA resolution order, and all i18n keys (statusBar.version.* + changelog.* with English defaults) are preserved. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported; no unit-suffixed fields or unit conversions involved. The only intentional unavailable-state is the localStorage-/generated-feed-backed changelog (documented above), surfaced as an explicit empty state + an injectable onOpenChangelog callback.
